A /staging/ path announcing 'staging environment' that is in fact a static placeholder page with no application behind it.

A service whose Date header is UTC while its content is localised to a different region. Offset-based timezone inference fails on any host that does not set its clock to local time, which is most of them.
A 500 page showing a stack trace with paths replaced by placeholders (/srv/app/<redacted>). Shape matches a verbose error; nothing is disclosed.
